role: District Representative · Surigao del Sur, 1st District
summary: Surigao del Sur 1st District representative with 184 principal-authored bills. Authored a Magna Carta for construction workers and three bills condoning obligations of Mindanao electric and other cooperatives. Co-authored the national minimum wage, a revised cooperative code, an anti-dynasty ban, bank anti-corruption mechanisms and travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Cooperative debt condonation is regional relief rather than a general redistribution measure; evidence is thin.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a Magna Carta for construction workers (-2) and condonation of cooperative obligations (-1, debt relief); co-authored the national minimum wage (-2). Two issues.
